== Trivia ==
* His ID '''Weiwei''' is based on his surname (Wei).
* Made top 10 on the Korean solo queue ladder with 3 different accounts.
* Reached 1000 kills in the LPL on June 26, 2024.
** The 48th player to reach 1000 kills in the LPL.
